---
title: "Notebook UX Contracts"
---

Public notebooks are a first-class OrPen SC PDK interface. SCGSim owns the
runtime APIs they call and does not keep duplicate notebook source.

## Palace notebook contract

Only `WORKFLOW_ACTION`, `RUN_ID`, and the run root are global controls. Every
other control is placed beside its immediate action in these stages:

```text
Build Component Coupon
-> Configure EPR / Problem
-> Build Mesh
-> Generate Config
-> Prepare Handoff
-> Analyze Returned Run
```

This contract permits Route A or Route B for the current Surface-EPR direction.
It publishes no private component, selector, dimension, screenshot, config,
mesh, receipt, or artifact.

Notebooks may set `amr_max_passes` (Palace `MaxIts`) and
`amr_nonconformal` (Palace `Model.Refinement.Nonconformal`).
`write_config()` always emits the `Nonconformal` key. The SCGSim default is
`false` so generated configs do not inherit Palace's `true` default. Set
`amr_nonconformal=True` only to opt into nonconformal AMR. Do not delete the
key from a generated config.

## AEDT notebook contract

AEDT examples use the same stage-local rule. Backend-specific setup remains
visible, but handoff construction, execution, native readback, hashes, and
result resolution stay in `scgsim.aedt`, not notebook-local helper code.
